name: Steven Belin
description: Black-and-white photographs by Steven Belin: street, light and place, from Stockholm and further afield.
statement: Photographs of people, light and the places in between. Mostly black and white, mostly Stockholm, made on the way to somewhere else.
about: I photograph the city as I move through it: commuters on escalators, a single lamp in a dark stairwell, a stranger holding still while the crowd rushes past.
I work with small, quiet cameras and keep the edit tight. Each series here is a short sequence, meant to be seen in order.
